items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Then I took this job with Ella. I didn't know anything about what her schedule was. I didn't realize how much traveling she did and what it was like. I was with her for two years, and it almost killed me.

ctx.x: Finally, I stayed here... Then finally Norman Granz called me. And I didn't realize how I was getting. Then I took this job with Ella. I didn't know anything about what her schedule was. I didn't realize how much traveling she did and what it was like. I was with her for two years, and it almost killed me. I wound up with emphysema, and I had to quit. So I went to Los Angeles, and, I was old enough to qualify for unemployment...
